regions.label: INESHeader
regions.evidence: Validated iNES header with 8 PRG-16K units,16 CHR-8K units and MMC3 mapper 4.

regions.label: CHRROM
regions.evidence: Header establishes entire CHR ROM storage; 8192 NES 16-byte 2bpp tiles. PPU-only cartridge pattern storage, separate from CPU PRG; graphical contents inspected in rendered startup.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Three little-endian NES vectors at CPU FFFA-FFFF: NMI C000, RESET FF97, IRQ C14A; fixed effective PRG bank 15.
